The method was tested only on forecasts made 3 and 5 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul 2026 to 17 Oct 2026: at 5 days ahead, 23% of the days it flagged crossed the line (2% of days did anyway) and it flagged 18% of the days that crossed. Days beyond 5 ahead were not tested. Those are day-by-day rates; this forecast is graded on its whole window.
